login.title: Sign in to rampflow
login.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Try again {{when}}.

magic.title: Sign in by link
magic.confirm: This link signs you in to the account below. Continue only if it is yours and you asked for the link.
magic.not_you: Not your account? Close this page. Nothing changes until you continue.
magic.request_hint: We send you a link that signs you in once. It works for 15 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Password changed. You are signed in, and every other session has ended.
reset.request_hint: We send you a link to set a new password. It works once for 60 minutes.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.magic: If {{email}} has an account, a sign-in link is on its way.
sent.reset: If {{email}} has an account, a link to reset the password is on its way.

link_invalid.title: This link no longer works
link_invalid.magic: Sign-in links work once and for 15 minutes. Ask for a new one.
link_invalid.reset: Reset links work once and for 60 minutes. Ask for a new one.

invite.title: Accept the invitation
invite.invalid: Invitations work once and for 7 days. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
invite.already_member: You are already a member of this organisation.
invite.sign_in_first: This email already has an account. Sign in to accept.

email.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.

magic_link.subject: Your sign-in link for rampflow
magic_link.preview: Sign in with one click. The link works for 15 minutes.
magic_link.intro: Use this button to sign in to rampflow. The link works once and for 15 minutes.

password_reset.subject: Reset your rampflow password
password_reset.preview: Set a new password. The link works for 60 minutes.
password_reset.intro: Use this button to set a new password. The link works once and for 60 minutes. Afterwards every other session ends.

invitation.subject: Your invitation to {{org}} on rampflow
invitation.intro: You are invited to join {{org}} on rampflow as {{role}}.
invitation.intro_by: {{inviter}} invites you to join {{org}} on rampflow as {{role}}.
invitation.expiry: The invitation works once and for 7 days.
